component-metadata.description:
A metanode for Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP) for dimensionality reduction. UMAP is performed using the umap R package (https://github.com/tkonopka/umap) version 0.2.8.0.
It is possible to perform UMAP either on columns or rows. UMAP cannot be performed on data with missing values, all rows in case of UMAP on columns or column in case of UMAP on rows will be filtered out.
Annotation can be displayed alongside the points in the UMAP plot. If UMAP is performed on columns, column headers will be used for annotation. For UMAP on rows, a column containing points annotations should be selected. It is possible to remove a common prefix or suffix from points annotations.
Points can be also grouped so that points from the same group will be filled with the same color. This is possible to do either manually (by manually entering the group of every individual point) or by selecting a column containing point groups (for UMAP on rows).
Note: any data pre-processing (normalization, missing value imputation) should be done before running this metanode!
